description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the I18NTranslationBulkAPI component within the OrangeHRM admin API namespace. It includes test methods for various API operations such as getOne, delete, and update, but only the update method appears to be fully implemented. The class extends a custom EndpointIntegrationTestCase and utilizes mock services for testing API behavior.
